### M1: Project Scaffolding ✅
- Monorepo with server/ + client/ workspaces
- Express 5 + Mongoose 8 + React 19 + Vite + Tailwind + Zustand
- Health check endpoint, dev scripts

### M2: Database Models ✅
- User (bcrypt pre-save hook, comparePassword, JWT auth)
- Persona (5-layer system prompt, trait clamping by archetype)
- Conversation (TTL, addMessage, getRecentMessages)
- SemanticMemory (BSON BinData embeddings, to/from buffer helpers)
- EpisodicMemory (summaries, emotional tone, topics)
- Ar…

### M7: Memory System (3-Layer RAG + Background Extraction)
- embeddingService (Voyage 4, embed/embedBatch, BSON BinData)
- memoryService (vector search + text search + dedup + decay)
- extractionService (GPT-4o-mini fact/preference extraction via BullMQ)
- Background jobs: memory extraction, decay, conversation summarization

### M8: Frontend (All Screens)
- DashboardPage: sidebar + chat + avatar layout
- MessageBubble: markdown rendering, streaming cursor
- ConversationList: fetch, select, de…
